question: Should OpenClaw accept Vault as a bundled plugin whose exec resolver receives Vault auth material and performs Vault network reads, or keep Vault as an external ClawHub/plugin package?
rationale: The code uses the existing SecretRef integration seam, but bundled distribution of a credential-handling network resolver is a maintainer/security trust-boundary decision that automation should not settle.

options.title: Keep Vault external unless explicitly sponsored
options.body: Use the existing claw-vault style plugin path by default, and only bundle Vault if a maintainer/security owner explicitly accepts the distribution and support burden.

options.title: Accept bundled Vault after cleanup
options.body: Fix the docs map and SDK-literal blockers, approve the current dependency graph, and land the bundled plugin with secops-owned review of the resolver boundary.

options.title: Narrow to core apply support
options.body: Split out any generic secrets-apply support that external plugin setup needs and leave the Vault resolver/package outside core.

recommendation.title: Keep Vault external unless explicitly sponsored
recommendation.body: Use the existing claw-vault style plugin path by default, and only bundle Vault if a maintainer/security owner explicitly accepts the distribution and support burden.

likelyOwner.reason: The unresolved choice is mainly a security/dependency and bundled-distribution boundary, and his history plus CODEOWNERS routing make him the best available owner from the inspected history.
